{{Quote|I remember the craters and trenches of Yn and Chabosh. The terror of the dying. It was glorious.|Khem Val|<ref name="Ambient Sobrik">{{TORcite|type=location|Ambient Khem Val dialogue in Sobrik|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Chabosh''' was a conflict between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and rebels<ref name="Exultation" /> around [[5300 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> in which the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] led an army of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors to capture the Jedi&ndash; and rebel&ndash;held [[Chabosh]] after he broke the Jedi [[Battle of Yn|siege]] of<ref name="Exultation" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|355|Yn}}</ref> [[Yn]].<ref name="Exultation" /> Hord, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ortan Cela]], and their [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]]s [[Khem Val]] and [[Veshikk Urk]]<ref name="The Master's Apprentice" /> led the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] offensive, and during the fighting,<ref name="Tomb" /> Urk and Val feasted on the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force potential]] of their enemies, and Tulak Hord used a [[Tulak Hord's ritual|ritual]] to draw the strength of his enemies into himself.<ref name="Ritual">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Ritual of Tulak Hord}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Chabosh was first mentioned in the entry for Khem Val on [[the Holonet]] portion of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} official site in [[2011]].<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|khem-val|Khem Val}}</ref> It was later expanded on in the game itself, in conversations with Khem Val<ref name="Exultation" /> and several Codex entries.<ref name="Ritual" />
